Every struct verified: contiguous bit tiling with no gaps/overlaps, declared width matches max bit + 1, unique member names, and each field's bit range matches its declared width. The enum is verified: exactly the six expected named states, all 3-bit encodings, no duplicate encodings, and a Reserved row confirmed present in source (whose two encodings are excluded from the emitted enum, not silently dropped).
